# TECHIBOY LLC

> TECHIBOY LLC (techiboyllc.com) is a custom logo design and brand identity studio. It designs bespoke logos, brand identity systems, logo redesigns, business branding, 3D & animated logos and brand strategy, with first concepts in as little as 24–48 hours and revisions until the client is happy.

Key facts:

- Website: https://techiboyllc.com/
- Contact: support@techiboyllc.com, or the project form at https://techiboyllc.com/#contact (replies within 24 hours)
- Track record stated on the site: 500+ logos delivered, 98% client satisfaction, 30+ industries served
- Clients own the final approved logo, with full copyright, once it is paid in full
- 100% satisfaction guarantee: free revisions until the client loves it, or a refund under the refund policy

## Pages

- [Home](https://techiboyllc.com/): services, portfolio, design process, pricing, client testimonials, FAQ and the contact form
- [Privacy Policy](https://techiboyllc.com/privacy.html): what information is collected and how it is used and protected
- [Terms & Conditions](https://techiboyllc.com/terms.html): services, ownership, trademarks, revisions, payment and delivery terms
- [Refund Policy](https://techiboyllc.com/refund.html): satisfaction guarantee, full and partial refund eligibility and how to request a refund

## Services

- Custom Logo Design: bespoke logos crafted from scratch (wordmarks, emblems, mascots)
- Brand Identity Systems: colour palettes, typography, iconography and usage guidelines
- Logo Redesign: modernising an outdated mark while keeping its brand equity
- Business Branding: business cards, letterheads, social media kits and branded collateral
- 3D & Animated Logos: dimensional logo treatments and motion animations for video intros and social reels
- Brand Strategy: research-driven positioning, competitor analysis and brand voice

## Pricing

Prices are per project in USD. Annual billing saves 20%.

- Starter: $50 ($40 with annual billing). 3 initial logo concepts, 2 rounds of revisions, PNG/JPG/SVG files, 48-hour first delivery.
- Pro (most popular): $100 ($80 with annual billing). 6 initial logo concepts, unlimited revisions, all file formats including PDF/EPS, 24-hour priority delivery, brand guidelines PDF, social media kit (10 templates).
- Enterprise: $150 ($120 with annual billing). Unlimited concepts and revisions, all formats plus source files, same-day express delivery, full brand identity system, social media kit (25 templates), 3D + animated logo intro.

## Process

1. Discovery: learning the brand story, industry, competitors and goals
2. Concept design: exploring several directions and refining the strongest into polished options
3. Refinement: fine-tuning colours, proportions and typography on the chosen concept
4. Final delivery: every format needed (PNG, SVG, PDF, EPS) plus brand guidelines

## Portfolio

- YAMA Events PTY LTD: premium 3D emblem with a metallic gold identity
- BLK Dunes: bold 3D wordmark with a chrome emblem icon
- Akshaya's Designer Studio: elegant monogram with a 3D orange chrome treatment
- EKA Financial Consultants: dimensional logo with a vibrant blue and orange palette
- MR Group: dynamic radial swoosh with a multi-colour gradient
- Mittri Engineering Pvt Ltd: industrial 3D gear mark with bold red and cyan branding

## FAQ

- How fast are first concepts? Within 48 hours on Starter, 24-hour priority on Pro and same-day express on Enterprise; times are estimates that depend on how quickly feedback comes back.
- How many revisions? Two rounds on Starter, unlimited on Pro and Enterprise; revisions should be requested within 14 days of each proof.
- Which files are delivered? PNG, JPG and SVG on Starter; all formats including PDF and EPS plus a brand guidelines PDF on Pro; source files as well on Enterprise.
- Is there a trademark check? A general visual review, not a formal trademark search; a trademark attorney is recommended before commercial use.
